seo.title: The Club at Weston Hills · Weddings, Mitzvahs & Celebrations
seo.description: Weddings, mitzvahs, quinceañeras and private events at The Club at Weston Hills: a newly renovated clubhouse on two Robert Trent Jones Jr. golf courses, for up to 320 guests. Music, lighting and production by Avinu Events.

hero.lead: A newly renovated clubhouse above two championship golf courses: ceremonies on the patio, receptions in the Royal Palm and room for up to 320 guests.

paras: The Club at Weston Hills sits on two courses designed by Robert Trent Jones Jr., the Tour Course and the Players Course, which have hosted the Honda Classic and the LPGA Chrysler Plymouth Tournament of Champions.

Its newly renovated 50,000-square-foot clubhouse, with white columns and a clock tower, opens onto fairways, fountains and tropical landscaping, with an events team and an in-house kitchen for every celebration.

items.label: Weddings
items.title: Weddings
items.text: Say “I do” on the patio overlooking the fairways and fountains, then move inside to the Royal Palm for dinner and dancing.
points: Ceremony music, DJ and lighting by Avinu Events
items.cta: Plan a wedding at Weston Hills

items.label: Bar & Bat Mitzvahs
items.title: Bar & Bat Mitzvahs
items.text: A ballroom with a spacious dance floor and golf-course views, with room for every generation and a team that has hosted mitzvahs at the club.
points: Spacious dance floor and cocktail-hour spaces
DJ, MC, dancers and LED by Avinu Events
items.cta: Plan a mitzvah at Weston Hills

items.label: Quinceañeras & Sweet 16
items.title: Quinceañeras & Sweet 16
items.text: From pink-lit quinceañeras to a Sweet 16 in gold and chandeliers, the club’s rooms transform with lighting, florals and a big entrance.
points: Indoor banquet rooms with dramatic lighting
Lounge for up to 60 for smaller parties
Choreography, lighting and effects by Avinu Events
items.cta: Plan a quince at Weston Hills

film.h2: From the patio to the dance floor
film.text: A ceremony facing the fairways, dinner in the Royal Palm and a dance floor that lasts all night. Choose a moment.

spaces.text: Indoor banquet rooms, an outdoor patio and lawn, and a lounge for smaller gatherings, all inside the renovated clubhouse.

items.name: Royal Palm
items.text: An elegant indoor venue with floor-to-ceiling windows and views of the golf course and fountains.

items.name: Glades Ballroom
items.text: A generous ballroom for larger receptions, galas and parties.

items.name: Patio & Lawn
items.text: Outdoor ceremonies overlooking the fairways, water features and tropical landscaping.

items.name: The Lounge
items.text: An intimate room for rehearsal dinners, showers and smaller celebrations.

spaces.note: Capacities from the club: up to 320 for weddings and 360 for private events. Confirm room capacities and layouts with the club’s events team.

production.text: Avinu Events produces the entertainment for celebrations across South Florida, from Miami Beach to Boca Raton: the music for the ceremony, the energy of the dance floor and the light that shapes the room.
production.lighting: Uplighting and pin-spotting for the Royal Palm’s tall windows and ceilings, dance-floor lighting, and sound designed for the patio ceremony.
